description: Supabase migration + type additions + new API functions. Creates the missing DB tables (holidays, exam_defs, fee_structures, payment_setups), adds father_name/mother_name/parent_email columns to students, adds the Holiday interface to src/types/index.ts, appends 13 new async functions to src/services/realApi.ts, and re-exports them from src/services/api.ts.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/20261022000000_005_missing_tables_and_columns.sql. Include: (a) ALTER TABLE students ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS father_name text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mother_name text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_email text; (b) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS holidays with columns id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), school_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES schools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, date date NOT NULL, type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('working','holiday','festival')), label text, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(school_id, date); enable RLS; policies: admin full CRUD (school_id = get_current_school_id() AND is_admin()), teacher SELECT (is_teacher() AND school_id = get_current_school_id()), parent SELECT (is_parent() AND school_id = get_current_school_id()); set_updated_at trigger. (c) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_defs with id uuid PK, school_id uuid NOT NULL FK→schools, section_id uuid NOT NULL FK→sections, exam_name text NOT NULL, record_type text NOT NULL, max_marks numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, date date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE, created_by_teacher_id uuid REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at, updated_at; enable RLS; indexes on school_id, section_id; policies: admin full CRUD, teacher INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on own section (via class_assignments), all roles SELECT own school; trigger. (d) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fee_structures with id uuid PK, school_id uuid NOT NULL FK→schools, name text NOT NULL, fee_type text NOT NULL, class_id uuid REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, amount numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, frequency text NOT NULL CHECK (frequency IN ('one_time','monthly','quarterly','annual')), due_day int, academic_year text NOT NULL DEFAULT '2025-2026', is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, created_at, updated_at, UNIQUE(school_id, name, academic_year); enable RLS; admin full CRUD; trigger. (e) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_setups with id uuid PK, school_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES schools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, razorpay_key_id text, account_holder_name text, bank_name text, account_number text, ifsc_code text, is_verified boolean DEFAULT false, created_at, updated_at; enable RLS; admin full CRUD; trigger. (f) Add teacher INSERT and UPDATE policies on students table: 'students_teacher_insert' WITH CHECK (is_teacher() AND school_id = get_current_school_id() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_assignments ca JOIN teachers t ON t.id = ca.teacher_id WHERE ca.section_id = students.section_id AND t.user_id = auth.uid())); 'students_teacher_update' USING same condition WITH CHECK same condition.

In src/types/index.ts, add the Holiday interface after the existing ExamDef interface: export interface Holiday { id: string; school_id: string; date: string; type: 'working' | 'holiday' | 'festival'; label: string | null; created_at: string; updated_at: string; }

In src/services/realApi.ts, add Holiday, ExamDef, FeeStructure, PaymentSetup to the existing type import at the top. Then append the following 13 exported async functions at the bottom of the file, following the exact supabase call pattern already used: fetchHolidays(schoolId), createHoliday, updateHoliday, deleteHoliday, fetchExamDefs(filters: {schoolId?,sectionId?}), createExamDef, deleteExamDef, fetchFeeStructures(schoolId), createFeeStructure, updateFeeStructure, deleteFeeStructure, fetchPaymentSetup(schoolId) [maybeSingle], upsertPaymentSetup [upsert on conflict column 'school_id' using .select().maybeSingle()].

In src/services/api.ts, add re-exports for all 13 new functions: export const fetchHolidays = api.fetchHolidays; ... etc. The file still uses the isMock conditional at this point — do NOT yet remove it (FEAT-002 handles that).
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/20261022000000_005_missing_tables_and_columns.sql exists and is valid SQL (no syntax errors detectable by reading).
src/types/index.ts exports a Holiday interface with the correct shape.

src/services/realApi.ts exports fetchHolidays, createHoliday, updateHoliday, deleteHoliday, fetchExamDefs, createExamDef, deleteExamDef, fetchFeeStructures, createFeeStructure, updateFeeStructure, deleteFeeStructure, fetchPaymentSetup, upsertPaymentSetup.
npm run typecheck exits 0 with no new errors introduced.
findings: 1. mockDb.ts required TableName union and SEED_DATA to include the 4 new tables (holidays, exam_defs, fee_structures, payment_setups) — done. 2. mockApi.ts required matching stub implementations for all 13 new functions so api.ts conditional dispatch type-checks — done. 3. ParentFees.tsx had a pre-existing TS2367 narrowing error (fee.status !== 'paid' after status had already been narrowed to exclude 'paid') — fixed with (fee.status as string) cast to preserve runtime behaviour. Later steps should be aware: isMock flag in api.ts is still intact per spec; FEAT-002 removes it.
